title: Codex Telegram Bridge
viewer: Hiring manager or general portfolio viewer
takeaway: Codex Telegram Bridge routes remote replies to the right local thread while local controls retain approvals and ownership.

scenes.intent: Codex kept working after I stepped away. Prompts could sit on the desktop.
scenes.headline: Prompts could wait on the desktop.
scenes.assetAlt: Public terminal-style Codex Telegram Bridge command surface.

scenes.intent: Remote control needed clear ownership. Chat should not become an open door.
scenes.headline: Remote control needed clear ownership.

scenes.intent: I built a local bridge. Away mode opens replies. Back mode closes them.
scenes.headline: A local bridge opens only when needed.
scenes.assetAlt: Public bridge command surface showing explicit remote-mode controls.

scenes.intent: Replies go back to the right thread. Approvals return to the same thread.
scenes.headline: Replies return to the right thread.

scenes.intent: Remote Codex stays controlled. Replies, approvals, and delivery stay tied to my machine.
scenes.headline: Remote Codex stays locally controlled.
scenes.assetAlt: Public bridge proof surface used for the controlled-delivery result.

scenes.intent: Replies under control. Local state keeps ownership.
scenes.headline: Remote replies under local control.
